stories.title: Show HN: NFC Energy-Harvesting PCB Business Card with an MCU
stories.summary: An engineer has built a battery-free near field communication business card. It uses twenty-one L. E. D. lights to run an animation when tapped against a phone. The design combines energy harvesting and a microcontroller in one credit card sized unit. The hardware uses an A. T. tiny eight sixteen microcontroller. It also features an N. X. P. N. T. A. G. I. two C. Plus chip. This chip harvests energy from the magnetic field of a smartphone. The designer added a startup circuit to manage power limits. It uses a ten microfarad capacitor and a resistor to limit inrush current. A P-channel MOSFET acts as a switch after one hundred twenty milliseconds. The L. E. D. lights are managed using six general purpose input output pins. The custom antenna was built using a Python script. It achieves an inductance of two point seven five microhenries and resonates at thirteen point fifty-six megahertz. The creator ordered thirty fully compliant units through J. L. C. P. C. B. Programming happens through three exposed pads using a special pin clip. Contact information and routing are handled by a mobile app linking to connect dot wilsonharper dot net. Hardware is hard is a phrase that rings true for this complex project.

stories.title: How AI agents "radicalized" a top Meta exec into quitting her job
stories.summary: Clara Shih, former C. E. O. of Salesforce A. I., has left Meta after being radicalized by observing how efficiently A. I. agents handle complex workplace tasks. Last fall at Meta, Shih watched A. I. agents compress a product development process down to just one or two people and a prototype. That process used to involve user researchers, designers, product managers, and three types of engineers. Seeing similar efficiency gains in marketing, distribution, and privacy review, Shih began canceling entry-level job postings because she no longer felt they were needed. Shih noted that the optimistic story she once told herself about her own products has primarily not been true. Specifically, Shih stated that the optimistic story about automating rote work to free customer support workers for higher-order tasks has primarily not been true. This spring, she stepped down from her operational role to launch the New Work Foundation. That organization is a nonprofit. She also launched a consumer brand called Dear CC. That brand provides free tools, a podcast, a data tool called Field Report, and a mentoring app called Game Plan for entry-level workers.

stories.title: Show HN: OpenTIE and OpenXWA, Modern Ports of Tie Fighter and X-Wing Alliance
stories.summary: Two new projects called OpenTIE and OpenXWA are now available as open-source versions of classic space combat games. These projects recreate Star Wars: TIE Fighter and Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance for Windows, macOS, and Linux. OpenTIE runs original game data natively on current computers. It supports both the nineteen ninety-five Collector's C. D. ROM edition and the nineteen ninety-eight Windows release. The software needs a complete installation from one of those supported editions. You can buy them from GOG and Steam because the new software does not include original game content. With both editions installed, OpenTIE lets players mix and match features. You can combine the nineteen ninety-five menus, cutscenes, and adaptive iMUSE soundtrack with the nineteen ninety-eight flight simulation and three D assets. OpenTIE brings modern technical upgrades to the old games. It adds high-resolution rendering and advanced lighting features like shadows, ambient occlusion, bloom, motion blur, H. D. R. output, and M. S. A. A. It also includes A. M. D. FidelityFX F. S. R. three point one point four anti-aliasing and upscaling. The flight simulation updates at up to two hundred forty hertz to match modern high-refresh-rate displays. Players can still choose original TIE ninety-five and TIE ninety-eight timing modes if they want exact historical behavior. The engine also features native support for modern gamepads and joysticks. Development packages and platform-specific instructions are waiting on G. i. t. H. u. b. Building the source requires a sixty-four-bit system with a modern G. P. U., C. Make three point two-three or later, a C or C plus plus toolchain, S. D. L. three point four, zstd, F. F. mpegg, and S. D. L. underscore shadercross.

stories.title: Show HN: We built open OpenRouter that turns usage into a better model
stories.summary: A new gateway is built natively in Rust for concurrency. It standardizes configuration quirks across different models and providers. This includes streaming formats, tool calls, model parameters, rate limits, and error behaviors. The system adds under one millisecond of latency for bring-your-own-key requests. It adds under two milliseconds when the platform supplies the provider key. It supports every major inference provider. It offers over one thousand models refreshed daily through a codex agent that automatically opens pull requests. This open-source tool takes no token markup compared to similar projects. It allows users to mix local models with a marketplace. It includes an opt-in program to use traffic for training a custom model. The system uses standardized O. Tel. traces and text world models to simulate rollouts for various models. An L. L. M. judge and a nearest neighbor classifier help decide the optimal model for each request. These simulations also enable suggestions for cache hit optimizations, new model options, and customized model training. Users can deploy the open-source software on their own infrastructure or use the hosted version.
